content.title: Chipotle price target lowered by Loop Capital, La-Z-Boy's Q2 beat
content.description:
Market Domination host Josh Lipton and Yahoo Finance senior reporter Brooke DiPalma track several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including crypto exchange Kraken's (KRAK.PVT) confidential filing for a US IPO, Loop Capital analysts lowering their price target on fast casual chain Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG), and furniture manufacturer La-Z-Boy (LZB) beating fiscal second quarter earnings estimates.

Also catch Yahoo Finance's full interview with Kraken co-CEO Arjun Sethi.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.

content.title: La-Z-Boy’s (NYSE:LZB) Q3 CY2025: Beats On Revenue, Stock Soars
content.summary: Furniture company La-Z-Boy (NYSE:LZB) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, but sales were flat year on year at $522.5 million. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $535 million at the midpoint, 1.1% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.71 per share was 31.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
